label_method: Phase 12 project-authored held-out engineering evaluation set. Constructed after freezing the v1 development/regression dataset and before running any Phase 12 comparative retrieval, chunking, threshold, or reranker experiment. Cases are drawn exclusively from the 20 of 39 indexed chunks never used as expected evidence in the v1 dataset, selected to cover exact_lexical, semantic, mixed, hard_negative, out_of_corpus, and adversarial_specificity categories where the corpus genuinely supports them, and to include long-section (>700 token) evidence for chunking-experiment sensitivity. Agent-authored against directly inspected indexed text; exact excerpts and provenance validated programmatically against the live corpus, identical process to the v1 dataset. No clinician or independent annotator review -- this is NOT an independently annotated, externally validated, or clinician-validated benchmark. No ranking-based label tuning; cases were not chosen or adjusted based on any retrieval, chunking, or threshold experiment outcome.

cases.query: What must a physician's prescription establish to support Medicare coverage of a hospital bed?

evidence.section: A. General Requirements for Coverage of Hospital Beds
evidence.quote: must establish the medical necessity for a hospital bed

cases.notes: Held-out set: previously unused NCD 227 section ('A. General Requirements'), distinct from the v1 dev set's Physician's Prescription/Variable Height/Electric Adjustment/Side Rails sections of the same NCD. Frozen before any comparative experiment.
